business_summary: Guangdong Hotata Technology Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of smart home products in China. The company offers smart home products, including smart clothes drying machines, smart door locks, and other smart products. It also provides clothes drying rack products, such as hand-crank drying racks, floor-standing drying racks, and hanging drying racks; as well as aluminum ladders, clothes rack sets, drying racks, towel racks, and other products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
